description: This file defines MCP (Metadata Control Plane) resources for schema discovery in the Superset project. It provides functions to generate schema metadata for chart, dataset, and dashboard models, including available columns, default columns, sortable columns, and search columns, as well as combined schema information.

methods.name: _build_schema_resource
methods.description: Builds schema metadata for a specified model type (chart, dataset, dashboard), including columns and sorting info.

methods.name: get_chart_schema_resource
methods.description: Returns JSON string with schema metadata for chart model.

methods.name: get_dataset_schema_resource
methods.description: Returns JSON string with schema metadata for dataset model.

methods.name: get_dashboard_schema_resource
methods.description: Returns JSON string with schema metadata for dashboard model.

methods.name: get_all_schemas_resource
methods.description: Returns JSON string with combined schema metadata for all models (chart, dataset, dashboard).
